$comment: Post-approval readback written 2026-09-01 by the orchestrator (Claude Fable 5.1). Every value below was read from the App Store Connect API or the public iTunes lookup endpoint at the recorded time; nothing is inferred. No external action was taken by the orchestrator: the release, phased-release completion, and storefront availability were performed by the Owner in App Store Connect.
method: scripts/asc_api.mjs raw GET (App Store Connect API, key referenced by ID only) + GET https://itunes.apple.com/lookup?id=6780714383&country=us

phasedRelease.interpretation: The Owner released 1.1 on 2026-09-01 and the phased rollout reads COMPLETE on day 1, i.e. released to all users.

availability.interpretation: The earlier 'removed from sale' storefront gap (submissionRecord.openStorefrontGap) reads as CLOSED: the app is returned by the public lookup and all 175 territories read available. The web-UI banner itself was not observed by the orchestrator.

remainingOwnerGatedSteps.detail: 1.1 (build 6, no NSUserTrackingUsageDescription) has replaced 1.0 on the storefront, so the ASC block on publishing Advertising Data tracking=NO should now be lifted. Re-enter App Privacy → Advertising Data → tracking NO and publish. Not settable via API.
Release AdMob app/unit IDs, frequency caps, and app-ads.txt remain Owner-unconfirmed against the AdMob console.
Three custom product pages per AppStore/1.1/custom-product-pages.json. Creating them is an ASC write and needs explicit Owner approval before the orchestrator acts.
Missing metrics are marked unmeasured, never zero.
